name: 3D Model
description: Make a 3D model (GLB with PBR materials) from a picture of an object, or from a description (a picture is made first). Runs on OAIY's engine (service engine:model3d) or a service you add.
doc:
Turns a picture of one object into a textured 3D model: a GLB (glTF 2.0) file with PBR materials, for game engines, 3D viewers and SoftN apps.

**From a picture** — connect it to Image. Any background works when the engine's model removes backgrounds; small pictures are enlarged first when it has an upscaler.

**From a description** — leave Image unconnected and describe the object (Description input or property): a picture of it is made first with Picture Service (OAIY's default image model), then the model. The picture comes out on Picture, so you can check it.

**Service** — `OAIY engine` uses the 3D model set up in OAIY's Engines (Pixal3D). Your own services (a Python rig in OAIY → Services, or a custom HTTP service) are sent the picture as a data: URL in `{{image}}` and should answer with the GLB (a file, base64, a URL, or a job that makes it).

**Out** — `Model` is a URL of the GLB; `Path` is the file (Copy File / File Write take it); `Picture` is the picture it was made from.

A model takes a few minutes on the GPU.

inputs.name: Image
inputs.description: A picture of one object (optional when a description is given)

inputs.name: Description
inputs.description: The object, when there is no picture: a picture of it is made first

outputs.name: Model
outputs.description: The 3D model: a URL of the GLB file

outputs.name: Picture
outputs.description: The picture the model was made from

properties.name: Service
properties.description: Which model or service makes the 3D model. Add models in OAIY's Engines, or your own services (Python rigs) in OAIY's Services.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: The object, when no picture is connected

properties.name: Picture Service
properties.description: What makes the picture from the description (only used without a connected picture)

properties.name: Seed
properties.description: The same seed gives the same model (-1 for a new one each time)

properties.name: Filename
properties.description: Base name for the GLB file
